theses.thesis: Growth durability: RSC subscription demand and the RAC AI-agent suite keep revenue growing at a high rate as the legacy CDM/RCDM-T transition ends.
theses.signpost: Revenue growth stays above 30% y/y with subscription quality intact; RAC becomes a visible driver of ARR growth; no sharp drop after the Subscription Credit tailwind fades.

theses.thesis: Operating leverage and cash conversion: opex discipline drives losses toward breakeven, and free cash flow stays self-funding.
theses.signpost: Operating margin improves y/y; gross margin holds near 80%; free cash flow margin stays at or above the prior-year level.

theses.thesis: Balance sheet and dilution: net cash and liquidity fund growth without eroding per-share value.
theses.signpost: Net cash stays near $600 million; share count growth slows toward low single digits; current ratio stays above 1.5x.

theses.thesis: T1: Subscription growth stays strong through fiscal 2027, supporting consensus revenue growth of about 28%.
theses.signpost: Subscription ARR growth at or above the signpost threshold in each quarterly report through the Q4 FY2027 report. Subscription ARR was not in the retrieved filings; revenue growth is used as a proxy.

theses.thesis: T2: Cash generation is durable, not only a function of upfront billing timing.
theses.signpost: Trailing-twelve-month free cash flow at or above the latest $286.2 million [2], with deferred revenue growth slowing.

theses.thesis: T3: The current valuation requires growth to stay near 29% for a decade; if growth fades to consensus, returns fall below the cost of capital.
theses.signpost: FY2027 revenue tracking at or above the $1.69 billion consensus, and FY2028 consensus growth holding above 21.7% in the next consensus update.

theses.thesis: T4: Operating leverage narrows losses as gross margin holds near 80% and operating expenses keep falling.
theses.signpost: GAAP operating margin improving from -26% in FY2026 toward break-even in FY2027, with gross margin at or above 80% of FY2026 levels.

theses.thesis: Balance sheet and dilution (from thesis log): net cash and liquidity fund growth without eroding per-share value.
theses.signpost: Net cash stays near $600 million; share count growth slows toward low single digits; current ratio stays above 1.5x.
